page.overview:
What is Zushi Zushi no Mi?

The Zushi Zushi no Mi is a Paramecia-type Devil Fruit which allows the user to create and manipulate gravitational forces. It was eaten by Issho, better known as Admiral Fujitora.

The eater of this fruit is granted the power to create and control gravitational forces with extreme potency. The user is able to move living things and objects with little effort, ranging from sending debris flying at an enemy in small or large scales, to moving a massive battleship. The range of the gravity field appears to be massive, as it can pull down meteors from the highest of skies (possibly the outer atmosphere or even space itself).

As demonstrated by Fujitora, the user can make the gravity move in any direction. They can move matter around with precision, effectively granting a form of telekinesis. Flight can be simulated by negating natural gravity and forcing things upward to navigate in midair, as shown by Fujitora flying by standing on a rock that he manipulates, or levitating a ship with himself and his men aboard. He is also able to manipulate multiple different gravitational fields simultaneously, as seen when fighting Luffy at the end of the Dressrosa Arc, where he kept vast amounts of rubble floating across an island-wide scale while attacking Luffy with offensive gravity wells.

However, it seems that the gravity powers can be disrupted by attacking Fujitora himself. This was shown when Roronoa Zoro used a projectile slash to interrupt the admiral from keeping him held down in a gravitational pin, enabling Zoro to escape from it. Also, people and objects are capable of resisting the gravity if they are physically strong enough to maintain a hold on their current position. In addition, it seems that the user is incapable of affecting themselves with the fruit; thus, they must create a platform to stand on in order to achieve flight. Other than all that, the user is also affected by the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.
